name: Kazama Sena
source: A fragile girl that Haruya met in the bus. She used to be a hyperactive girl who liked to play soccer with her friends, but she lost her confidence due to difference in girl and boy body after they growing up. As a result, she's grown into a quiet girl. She wants to hide her big bust as much as possible so she wears plain clothes.
